'''Asping rot''' is an [[herb]] that can be brewed into a tea. It is a very potent poison. A single drop of asping rot can kill quickly, though peacefully, within an hour of taking it. [[Verin Mathwin]] used the tea to get around her [[Black Ajah#Replacing the Three Oaths|dark oaths]] and pass on information to [[Egwene al'Vere]].{{ref/book|12|39}}
